points.K18: 过滤前补溶剂、润湿滤纸

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，台上有一瓶白色晶体和锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with a jar of white crystals and an Erlenmeyer flask, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课学重结晶，把固体提纯。

shots.scene: 单溶剂和双溶剂两个图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: one flask with a single droplet symbol, and one flask with two droplets of different colors. No people.
shots.narration: 单溶剂和双溶剂两种做法都会讲。

shots.scene: 阿杰举起一瓶发黄、结块的固体，皱眉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds up a jar of yellowish, lumpy solid and frowns.
shots.narration: 阿杰合成的产物，颜色发黄还结块。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起大烧杯准备倒入很多溶剂，小研摆手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a big beaker ready to pour in lots of solvent; the female graduate student waves her hand to stop him.
shots.narration: 他想倒一大杯溶剂泡一泡。

shots.scene: 小研拿出一排试管和几瓶溶剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sets out a rack of test tubes and a few solvent bottles with blank labels.
shots.narration: 小研说：重结晶要一步一步来。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and nods.
shots.narration: 我们按步骤来。

shots.scene: 欣欣捧着装有小晶体的表面皿
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a watch glass with sparkling small crystals.
shots.narration: 做化学实验，很多时间花在纯化上。

shots.scene: 蒸馏、色谱、重结晶三个图标，重结晶图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a distillation flask, a chromatography column and a flask with crystals; the crystal icon glows. No people.
shots.narration: 纯化方法多，重结晶专门对付晶体固体。

shots.scene: 白色片状晶体的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of white flaky crystals piled on a watch glass. No people.
shots.narration: 这次的样品，是白色的萘。

shots.scene: 五个台阶依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Five steps of a staircase light up one after another, each with a simple icon. No people.
shots.narration: 重结晶一共五步。

shots.scene: 试管架与热锥形瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a test tube rack and a warm Erlenmeyer flask with gentle steam lines. No people.
shots.narration: 先选溶剂，再用最少量热溶剂溶解。

shots.scene: 活性炭和漏斗图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a small heap of black powder and a funnel with folded filter paper. No people.
shots.narration: 需要时脱色，并趁热滤掉不溶物。

shots.scene: 锥形瓶中长出晶体，旁边是布氏漏斗
shots.prompt_en: An Erlenmeyer flask with crystals forming inside, next to a porcelain filter funnel on a filter flask. No people.
shots.narration: 冷却析出晶体，最后过滤、洗涤、干燥。

shots.scene: 一个溶剂瓶和两个溶剂瓶的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of one solvent bottle and of two solvent bottles joined by a plus sign. No people.
shots.narration: 按溶解性，可用一种溶剂或两种溶剂。

shots.scene: 小研站在一排空白标签的溶剂瓶前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands in front of a shelf of solvent bottles with blank labels.
shots.narration: 选溶剂最关键，选错了结果不会好。

shots.scene: 小研翻阅空白的文献资料
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student flips through a blank reference book at a desk.
shots.narration: 有文献溶解度数据，先查一查缩小范围。

shots.scene: 几瓶候选溶剂被圈出
shots.prompt_en: Three of the solvent bottles are circled by a glowing outline. No people.
shots.narration: 再挑几个候选，做溶解度试验。

shots.scene: 红色火焰图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A red open flame icon under a flask, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 有机溶剂易燃，绝不能用明火加热。

shots.scene: 加热板上的水浴
shots.prompt_en: A water bath in a glass dish sitting on an electric hot plate. No people.
shots.narration: 试验和重结晶，都用热水浴加热。

shots.scene: 小研往大结晶皿里倒水到一半
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours water into a large glass crystallizing dish until it is about half full.
shots.narration: 大结晶皿装一半水，放在加热板上。

shots.scene: 几粒沸石落入水中
shots.prompt_en: A few small white boiling stones drop into the water of the dish. No people.
shots.narration: 放几粒沸石，再开始加热。

shots.scene: 加热板旋钮转到中间位置
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a hot plate knob turned to the middle position. No people.
shots.narration: 旋钮别一开到底，先开一半再调。

shots.scene: 四支空白标签的试管，各放少量白色晶体
shots.prompt_en: Four test tubes with blank labels, each holding a small pinch of white crystals. No people.
shots.narration: 每支试管放二十毫克左右样品。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手往试管里加少量溶剂并轻摇
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand adds a small amount of liquid to a test tube and swirls it gently.
shots.narration: 加半毫升溶剂，摇一摇。

shots.scene: 小研看表等待，记录在空白本上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks her watch and writes in a blank notebook.
shots.narration: 等几分钟，记下溶没溶。

shots.scene: 两支试管里固体还在，两支已澄清
shots.prompt_en: Four test tubes: the first two still have solid at the bottom, the last two are clear. No people.
shots.narration: 室温下，萘不溶于水和乙醇。

shots.scene: 后两支澄清试管的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the two clear test tubes. No people.
shots.narration: 在丙酮和甲苯里，室温就溶了。

shots.scene: 试管夹夹住两支试管放进水浴
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand uses a test tube clamp to lower two test tubes into the warm water bath.
shots.narration: 还有固体的试管，夹好放进水浴。

shots.scene: 试管里溶剂微微沸腾
shots.prompt_en: Close view of liquid in a test tube gently boiling in the water bath. No people.
shots.narration: 加热到溶剂沸腾，摇一摇再看。

shots.scene: 水管仍有固体，乙醇管澄清
shots.prompt_en: Two test tubes after heating: one still has solid, the other is clear. No people.
shots.narration: 热水里萘还是不溶，热乙醇里溶了。

shots.scene: 冷的雪花和热的火苗两个图标，一个瓶里有晶体一个澄清
shots.prompt_en: Two panels: a snowflake icon above a flask with solid, and a warm icon above a clear flask. No people.
shots.narration: 理想溶剂：室温不溶，沸腾时溶解。

shots.scene: 丙酮、甲苯两瓶被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two solvent bottles with blank labels are crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 丙酮、甲苯室温就溶，不合适。

shots.scene: 水瓶被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A water bottle icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 水煮沸了也不溶，也不行。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起乙醇瓶竖大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a solvent bottle with a blank label and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 所以选乙醇！

shots.scene: 小研把装溶剂的锥形瓶用烧瓶夹固定在铁架台上，浸入水浴
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student clamps an Erlenmeyer flask of solvent to a ring stand and lowers it into the water bath.
shots.narration: 在水浴里预热一瓶乙醇。

shots.scene: 沸石落进锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: A few boiling stones drop into the cool solvent in the flask. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶里同样加沸石。

shots.scene: 烧瓶夹拧紧的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a gloved hand tightening the clamp around the flask neck.
shots.narration: 夹子夹牢，免得烧瓶倾倒。

shots.scene: 刮勺从样品瓶中挑出一粒晶体放在一旁
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand uses a spatula to pick one small crystal out of a sample vial and set it aside on a watch glass.
shots.narration: 加溶剂前，先留出一小粒晶体。

shots.scene: 其余样品倒入锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: The rest of the white sample is tipped into an empty Erlenmeyer flask.
shots.narration: 以后不好析晶时，它能派上用场。

shots.scene: 小研一手用夹子拿锥形瓶，一手用滴管加热溶剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the sample flask with a clamp in one hand and adds hot solvent with a dropper in the other.
shots.narration: 热溶剂要少量多次地加。

shots.scene: 锥形瓶在水浴中轻轻摇动
shots.prompt_en: The flask is swirled gently while dipped in the warm water bath.
shots.narration: 每加一次，摇一摇、热一热。

shots.scene: 固体刚好全部溶解，溶液澄清
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the last bits of solid disappearing into a clear solution. No people.
shots.narration: 样品刚好溶完就停。

shots.scene: 溶剂少回收多、溶剂多回收少的对比
shots.prompt_en: Two flasks compared: little solvent with a big crystal heap icon, much solvent with a tiny crystal heap icon. No people.
shots.narration: 溶剂越少，最后回收的晶体越多。

shots.scene: 瓶底剩几颗不溶颗粒，箭头标出
shots.prompt_en: A few stubborn particles remain at the bottom of a clear solution, marked by an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 总有一点溶不掉？多半是杂质。

shots.scene: 继续猛加溶剂的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a big stream of solvent being poured into the flask, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别为它一直加溶剂。

shots.scene: 淡黄色溶液放在白纸上
shots.prompt_en: A pale yellow solution in an Erlenmeyer flask set on a white paper. No people.
shots.narration: 看看溶液颜色对不对。

shots.scene: 白色晶体图标旁是黄色溶液图标，问号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of white crystals next to an icon of a yellow solution with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 该得白色晶体，溶液却发黄，有杂质。

shots.scene: 一小堆黑色粉末
shots.prompt_en: A small heap of fine black charcoal powder on a weighing paper. No people.
shots.narration: 少量有色杂质，可以用活性炭吸附。

shots.scene: 锥形瓶离开水浴，温度计图标下降一点
shots.prompt_en: The flask is lifted out of the water bath; a thermometer icon beside it drops slightly. No people.
shots.narration: 加炭之前，先让溶液稍低于沸点。

shots.scene: 往沸腾溶液加炭、液体冲出瓶口的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of black powder added to a boiling flask with liquid foaming over the rim, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 沸腾时加炭，会猛烈冒泡溢出来。

shots.scene: 刮勺加入一小撮活性炭，溶液变黑
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand adds a small pinch of black powder with a spatula; the solution turns dark.
shots.narration: 只加一小撮活性炭。

shots.scene: 一大勺活性炭吸走晶体图标的示意
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a big scoop of charcoal pulling crystal icons out of the solution, with a warning mark. No people.
shots.narration: 加多了，连产物也会被吸走。

shots.scene: 锥形瓶回到水浴，钟表图标
shots.prompt_en: The darkened flask goes back into the water bath next to a small clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 摇匀后在水浴里煮两三分钟。

shots.scene: 黑色溶液特写，细小颗粒悬浮
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the dark solution with very fine particles floating. No people.
shots.narration: 炭粉很细，直接过滤不好滤。

shots.scene: 刮勺加入一点白色助滤剂粉末
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand adds a little white filter aid powder to the dark solution.
shots.narration: 加少量助滤剂，把炭粉吸附住。

shots.scene: 锥形瓶回水浴加热
shots.prompt_en: The flask is swirled and placed back in the water bath. No people.
shots.narration: 摇匀再热两三分钟，然后趁热过滤。

shots.scene: 无色溶液中有几粒不溶固体
shots.prompt_en: A colorless solution with a few undissolved specks at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 溶液无色可不脱色，但要找不溶物。

shots.scene: 折叠成扇形的滤纸放在短颈漏斗里
shots.prompt_en: A fluted filter paper sits in a short-stem glass funnel on top of a clean Erlenmeyer flask. No people.
shots.narration: 有不溶物，用折叠滤纸趁热重力过滤。

shots.scene: 抽滤装置图标打叉，漏斗上结满晶体
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a vacuum filter funnel with crystals stuck on the paper, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 抽滤会让溶液变冷，晶体卡在滤纸上。

shots.section_title: 过滤前补溶剂、润湿滤纸
shots.scene: 滴管往样品瓶里多加一些热溶剂
shots.prompt_en: A dropper adds some extra hot solvent to the sample flask in the water bath.
shots.narration: 过滤前，多加一点溶剂并加热到沸。
overlay: 过滤前补溶剂、润湿滤纸

shots.section_title: 过滤前补溶剂、润湿滤纸
shots.scene: 过滤中途溶液不析出的示意
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a funnel with clear liquid flowing through and no crystals, a check mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 这样过滤时，产物不会提前析出。

shots.section_title: 过滤前补溶剂、润湿滤纸
shots.scene: 滴管把热溶剂滴在折叠滤纸上
shots.prompt_en: A dropper wets the fluted filter paper with hot solvent.
shots.narration: 先用热溶剂把滤纸润湿。

shots.section_title: 过滤前补溶剂、润湿滤纸
shots.scene: 用夹子提起热瓶，把溶液倒进漏斗
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand lifts the hot flask with a clamp and pours the solution into the funnel.
shots.narration: 用夹子拿热瓶，把溶液倒进去。

shots.scene: 用热溶剂荡洗原瓶，再倒进漏斗
shots.prompt_en: Hot solvent is swirled in the emptied flask and poured into the funnel.
shots.narration: 原瓶用热溶剂荡洗两三次，都倒进去。

shots.scene: 滴管沿滤纸边缘冲洗
shots.prompt_en: A dropper rinses the edge of the filter paper with hot solvent.
shots.narration: 最后冲一冲滤纸，减少损失。

shots.scene: 接收瓶里出现白色晶体，回水浴后消失
shots.prompt_en: White crystals appear in the receiving flask, then dissolve again after it is warmed in the water bath. No people.
shots.narration: 滤液里析出晶体不要紧，一热就溶。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起提醒牌（空白）
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises a blank reminder card with an exclamation icon.
shots.narration: 注意：现在溶剂不是最少量了。

shots.scene: 滤液在水浴中沸腾，液面下降
shots.prompt_en: The filtrate boils gently in the water bath and the liquid level goes down. No people.
shots.narration: 煮掉多余溶剂，直到开始出现固体。

shots.scene: 滴管补一点热溶剂，固体溶解
shots.prompt_en: A dropper adds a little hot solvent and the new solid dissolves again.
shots.narration: 再补一点热溶剂，让它刚好溶解。

shots.scene: 用圆形滤纸盖住瓶口
shots.prompt_en: A round filter paper is placed over the mouth of the flask as a cover.
shots.narration: 盖住瓶口，防止灰尘落进去。

shots.scene: 锥形瓶静置在台面上，周围安静
shots.prompt_en: The covered flask rests still on the bench, with a small do-not-touch hand icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 放在室温下，不摇不碰，自然冷却。

shots.scene: 锥形瓶放进塞了纸巾的烧杯
shots.prompt_en: The flask sits inside a beaker stuffed with paper towels around it. No people.
shots.narration: 放进塞纸巾的烧杯，冷得更慢。

shots.scene: 大颗晶体缓慢长出的示意
shots.prompt_en: Large clear crystals slowly growing in the flask, with a slow clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 冷得慢，晶体长得好，冷天更有用。

shots.scene: 瓶中针状晶体渐渐长满
shots.prompt_en: Needle-like crystals gradually fill the solution in the flask. No people.
shots.narration: 顺利的话，冷着冷着晶体就出来了。

shots.scene: 小研盯着清澈的溶液，挠头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks at a still clear solution and scratches her head.
shots.narration: 到了室温还没晶体？试试小技巧。

shots.scene: 玻璃棒轻刮瓶底
shots.prompt_en: A glass rod gently scratches the inner bottom of the flask.
shots.narration: 先用玻璃棒轻刮瓶壁或瓶底。

shots.scene: 用力按压、瓶子裂开的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a rod pressed hard with a cracking flask, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别太用力，小心把瓶子刮破。

shots.scene: 把预留的那粒晶种投进瓶里
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand drops the saved small crystal into the flask.
shots.narration: 还不行，就投进开头留的晶种。

shots.scene: 玻璃棒蘸溶液后放在空中晾干，表面出现白霜
shots.prompt_en: A glass rod dipped in the solution is held up to dry, and a thin white frost of tiny crystals forms on its tip. No people.
shots.narration: 忘了留？玻璃棒蘸点溶液晾干。

shots.scene: 带白霜的玻璃棒伸回溶液
shots.prompt_en: The frosted glass rod is dipped back into the solution.
shots.narration: 表面长出微晶，再伸回去引晶。

shots.scene: 锥形瓶放进冰水浴
shots.prompt_en: The flask with crystals is placed into an ice water bath. No people.
shots.narration: 析晶后降到室温，再放进冰浴。

shots.scene: 钟表图标指针转过一刻钟
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon with its hand sweeping a quarter of the face beside the ice bath. No people.
shots.narration: 冰浴至少十五分钟，再收集晶体。

shots.scene: 冰水浴里放着一瓶冷乙醇
shots.prompt_en: A small flask of solvent chilling in an ice water bath with a dropper beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 准备一瓶冰冷的溶剂，这里是乙醇。

shots.scene: 抽滤瓶夹在铁架台上，上面装瓷漏斗
shots.prompt_en: A thick-walled filter flask clamped to a stand with a porcelain filter funnel on top, connected by a hose. No people.
shots.narration: 再搭好抽滤装置。

shots.scene: 干净干燥的抽滤瓶特写，对勾
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a clean dry filter flask with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 接滤液的瓶子要干净、干燥。

shots.scene: 母液瓶旁出现第二堆小晶体
shots.prompt_en: A flask of mother liquor next to a second small heap of crystals with a number two icon. No people.
shots.narration: 母液浓缩再结晶，常能得第二批晶体。

shots.scene: 滤纸放进漏斗，滴冷溶剂润湿
shots.prompt_en: A filter paper is laid in the porcelain funnel and wetted with a few drops of cold solvent.
shots.narration: 打开真空，用少量冷溶剂润湿滤纸。

shots.scene: 把晶体连同母液倒进漏斗
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand pours the crystals and liquid from the flask into the funnel.
shots.narration: 把晶体连同母液倒进漏斗。

shots.scene: 冷溶剂荡洗瓶内残留晶体
shots.prompt_en: Cold solvent from a dropper rinses the remaining crystals out of the flask into the funnel.
shots.narration: 瓶里剩下的，用冷溶剂冲下来。

shots.scene: 滴管在晶体上滴加冷溶剂
shots.prompt_en: A dropper adds cold solvent over the crystal cake in the funnel.
shots.narration: 用冷溶剂洗晶体。

shots.scene: 空气被抽过晶体的示意箭头
shots.prompt_en: Arrows show air being pulled down through the crystal cake in the funnel. No people.
shots.narration: 继续抽几分钟气，开始干燥。

shots.scene: 刮勺把晶体刮到称量皿上摊开
shots.prompt_en: A spatula scrapes the crystals onto a weighing dish and spreads them out. No people.
shots.narration: 刮到称量皿上，摊开便于干燥。

shots.scene: 干燥器、烘箱、真空管路三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a glass desiccator, a lab oven and a vacuum line. No people.
shots.narration: 按化合物性质，选干燥器、烘箱或真空。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在两瓶溶剂中间
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between two solvent bottles with blank labels.
shots.narration: 找不到单一好溶剂？用两种溶剂。

shots.scene: 溶剂一中晶体室温溶解
shots.prompt_en: A flask labeled with a number one icon: crystals dissolve at room temperature. No people.
shots.narration: 溶剂一：室温下就能溶解样品。

shots.scene: 溶剂二中晶体沸腾也不溶
shots.prompt_en: A flask labeled with a number two icon: crystals stay undissolved even while it boils. No people.
shots.narration: 溶剂二：煮沸了也不溶。

shots.scene: 两种液体混在一起不分层，对勾；分两层的打叉
shots.prompt_en: Left: two liquids mix into one clear layer with a check mark; right: two separate layers crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 两者还要任意比例互溶，不能分层。

shots.scene: 丙酮和甲苯两瓶，问号
shots.prompt_en: Two solvent bottles with blank labels side by side and a question mark above. No people.
shots.narration: 丙酮、甲苯室温都溶，选谁当溶剂一？

shots.scene: 水瓶被圈出
shots.prompt_en: A water bottle icon circled with a glowing outline. No people.
shots.narration: 要看溶剂二，水是好候选。

shots.scene: 丙酮加水成一层，甲苯加水分两层
shots.prompt_en: Two test tubes: one mixture forms a single clear layer, the other separates into two layers. No people.
shots.narration: 丙酮能和水互溶，甲苯不能。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖大拇指，丙酮和水两瓶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up next to two bottles with blank labels.
shots.narration: 就选丙酮配水。

shots.scene: 滴管加热丙酮，溶液澄清
shots.prompt_en: A dropper adds hot solvent to the flask until the solution is clear.
shots.narration: 先用最少量热溶剂一溶解，得到澄清液。

shots.scene: 滴管逐滴加水，溶液变浑
shots.prompt_en: A dropper adds water drop by drop and the solution turns cloudy.
shots.narration: 再一滴一滴加溶剂二，直到变浑。

shots.scene: 锥形瓶摇动加热，浑浊不消失
shots.prompt_en: The cloudy flask is swirled and warmed in the bath; it stays cloudy. No people.
shots.narration: 摇匀加热，浑浊不退才算数。

shots.scene: 水滴落下处一闪即逝的白雾
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a brief white swirl where a drop hits the liquid, fading at once. No people.
shots.narration: 滴下时一闪而过的浊雾，不算浑浊。

shots.scene: 滴管滴加热丙酮，溶液刚好变清
shots.prompt_en: A dropper adds hot solvent drop by drop until the cloudy solution just turns clear.
shots.narration: 再逐滴加热的溶剂一，刚好变清就停。

shots.scene: 锥形瓶盖好静置冷却
shots.prompt_en: The covered flask rests on the bench to cool. No people.
shots.narration: 然后静置冷却，等晶体析出。

shots.scene: 两种溶剂按比例倒进小瓶并放进冰浴
shots.prompt_en: Two solvents are poured into a small flask in a set ratio, then the flask is chilled in an ice bath. No people.
shots.narration: 按相近比例配一份冷的混合溶剂。

shots.scene: 用冷混合溶剂洗涤漏斗中的晶体
shots.prompt_en: A dropper washes the crystals in the porcelain funnel with the cold mixed solvent.
shots.narration: 用它来转移和洗涤晶体。

shots.scene: 小研在书桌前翻阅空白实验讲义
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a blank lab manual at a desk with a notebook.
shots.narration: 看演示只是预习，代替不了读讲义。

shots.scene: 原理书本和操作手两个图标相加
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a book and a gloved hand joined by a plus sign. No people.
shots.narration: 原理和操作，都要弄明白。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现试管架和水浴图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a test tube rack and a water bath.
shots.narration: 试验选溶剂：冷不溶、热能溶。

shots.scene: 滴管与锥形瓶、活性炭和折叠滤纸图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a dropper with a flask, a pile of charcoal and a fluted filter paper. No people.
shots.narration: 最少量热溶剂，脱色后趁热过滤。

shots.scene: 盖好的锥形瓶、玻璃棒和冰浴图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a covered flask, a glass rod and an ice bath. No people.
shots.narration: 慢慢冷却，刮擦或晶种，再冰浴。

shots.scene: 布氏漏斗和两瓶溶剂图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a filter funnel and two solvent bottles. No people.
shots.narration: 冷溶剂洗涤；双溶剂浑浊再变清。

shots.scene: 欣欣捧着闪亮的晶体挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up shiny crystals and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 晶体纯又亮，下次见！
